Experience and knowledge of the HVAC Market, Associates Degree or equivalent education.

Define operational requirements and partner with the Director of Technology on adopting industry-leading tools.
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Manufacturing, Materials, or a related engineering discipline.
